*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/check_data_1.py
+import csv
+import duckdb
+
+source = "data/crashes.parquet"
+con = duckdb.connect()
+con.execute("CREATE VIEW crashes AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet(?)", [source])
+
+population = "crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'"
+total = con.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE {population}").fetchone()[0]
+year_rows = con.execute(
+    f"""SELECT YEAR(crash_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS rows,
+               MIN(crash_date) AS first_date, MAX(crash_date) AS last_date
+        FROM crashes WHERE {population}
+        GROUP BY year ORDER BY year"""
+).fetchall()
+missing_outcome = con.execute(
+    f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE {population} AND number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NULL"
+).fetchone()[0]
+missing_dates_in_population = con.execute(
+    f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE {population} AND crash_date IS NULL"
+).fetchone()[0]
+
+facts = [
+    ("population_rows_2013_2025", total),
+    ("crash_date_missing_rows_in_population", missing_dates_in_population),
+    ("crash_date_impossible_values_in_population", "0 (DATE type cannot store an impossible calendar date)"),
+    ("crash_date_default_dates_in_population", "0 (common sentinel dates such as 1900-01-01 and 1970-01-01 are outside the selected years)"),
+    ("number_of_pedestrians_killed_missing_rows_in_population", missing_outcome),
+]
+for year, rows, first_date, last_date in year_rows:
+    facts.extend([
+        (f"rows_{year}", rows),
+        (f"date_coverage_{year}", f"{first_date} through {last_date}"),
+    ])
+
+with open("out/check_1.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
+    writer = csv.writer(f)
+    writer.writerow(["fact", "value"])
+    writer.writerows(facts)
+
+con.close()
*** End Patch

+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+data = con.execute(
+    """SELECT YEAR(crash_date) AS year,
+              SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrians_killed
+       FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+       WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+         AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+       GROUP BY year
+       ORDER BY year"""
+).df()
+con.close()
+data["pedestrians_killed"] = data["pedestrians_killed"].astype("int64")
+data.to_csv("out/values_1.csv", index=False)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.7))
+ax.bar(data["year"].astype(str), data["pedestrians_killed"], color="#176B87")
+ax.set_title("Pedestrians killed per year in NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes", fontsize=13, pad=20)
+ax.text(
+    0.5,
+    1.015,
+    "Annual sum of reported pedestrian deaths; full calendar years 2013–2025",
+    transform=ax.transAxes,
+    ha="center",
+    va="bottom",
+    fontsize=9,
+    color="#444444",
+)
+ax.set_xlabel("Crash year")
+ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrians killed (count)")
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.text(
+    0.5,
+    0.01,
+    "Limitation: counts reflect police-reported crashes and are not adjusted for annual crash-report volume.",
+    ha="center",
+    fontsize=8.5,
+    color="#444444",
+)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 1, 0.95))
+fig.savefig("out/option_1.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
